definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: The net amount of nonoperating interest income (expense).
definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2024: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2024: Amount of interest income classified as operating and nonoperating.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Amount of interest revenue (income derived from investments in debt securities and on cash and cash equivalents) net of interest expense (cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest).
definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2024: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.
definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2024: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.
Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.
Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.
Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.
Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (that is, noncontrolling interest, previously referred to as minority interest).
definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2023: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.
The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.
The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).
Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
Amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity, classified as other equity.

As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.
The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.
definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2023: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.
definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2023: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

definition_changes_in_reviewed_releases.2021: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.
Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.
Amount allocated to previously issued preferred shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.
The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.
The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

production_concept_review.scope: Current US GAAP metrics only; not proof of all possible derivations or all permitted filing structures.

definition_candidates.scope: Candidate screening, not approval or universal proof.

ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTax.2021: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxIncludingPort.2021: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.2021: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.2021: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations.2021: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAttrib.2021: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.2021: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsInclud.2021: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.2021: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments.2021: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.2021: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

InterestExpense.2021: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.
InterestExpense.2024: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

InterestExpenseOperating.2024: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

InterestIncomeOperating.2021: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonoperating.2024: Amount of interest income classified as operating and nonoperating.

LiabilitiesNoncurrent.2021: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

LiabilitiesOtherThanLongtermDebtNoncurre.2021: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

LimitedLiabilityCompanyLlcMembersEquityI.2021: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.

LongTermDebt.2021: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.
LongTermDebt.2022: Amount, excluding unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.
LongTermDebt.2023: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

LongTermDebtCurrent.2021: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.
LongTermDebtCurrent.2023: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

LongTermDebtNoncurrent.2021: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.
LongTermDebtNoncurrent.2022: Amount, excluding unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.
LongTermDebtNoncurrent.2023: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

MembersEquity.2021: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.

MembersEquityAttributableToNoncontrollin.2021: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.

NetIncomeLoss.2021: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollin.2021: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

OperatingCostsAndExpenses.2021: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

OperatingExpenses.2021: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTax.2021: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax.2021: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPort.2021: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.
Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTax.2021: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss).

ProfitLoss.2021: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue.2021: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

RegulatedOperatingRevenue.2021: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer.2021: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomerExclud.2021: Amount, excluding interest income, of revenue not accounted for under Topic 606.

Revenues.2021: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.2021: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

SecuredLongTermDebt.2021: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.

SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.2021: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

UnregulatedOperatingRevenue.2021: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

UnsecuredLongTermDebt.2021: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

definition_screening.order: Sorted qualified names of US GAAP 2026 monetary schema elements; definitions from official documentation linkbase. Ranges are inclusive.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read definitions. These are component balances, flows, adjustments and restricted scopes, not additional whole-company totals. Component current/noncurrent and gross/allowance identities do not establish an exhaustive partition into the four main metrics.
candidates: AccretionExpenseIncludingAssetRetirementObligations = AccretionExpense + AssetRetirementObligationAccretionExpense is a component identity; root expense partition remains unestablished.
Net income from cash flow minus total reconciliation adjustments needs proof of income scope (parent/consolidated and continuing/discontinued); not approved solely from generic net-income wording.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition, including rereading truncated ranges. Acquisition-date and acquired-business amounts, regulatory capital, insurance closed blocks, and commitments are not substitutes for consolidated recognized balances. Gross/net, current/noncurrent and asset-class partitions require matching scope and complete inputs.
candidates: AssetsNoncurrentOtherThanNoncurrentInvestmentsAndPropertyPlantAndEquipment requires an exact complementary investment/property total; adding receivables may overlap.
Consolidated comprehensive income minus consolidated other comprehensive income may recover ProfitLoss; check complementary definitions and tax/noncontrolling scope.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition. Contract assets and receivables have gross/net and current/noncurrent components but do not complete a company asset partition. Contractual obligations include commitments; debt principal, periodic cash interest, debt fees and accrued interest cannot replace total recognized interest expense. Debt securities are investments, with amortized-cost/fair-value, credit-loss and accrued-interest variants that cannot be mixed. CostOfRevenue and CostsAndExpenses support the existing cost subtraction; related-party costs and industry-specific costs are subsets.

Read every definition, including rereading derivative ranges truncated in output. Debt security and deferred cost amounts are component balances, not total assets. Deferred tax balances distinguish jurisdictional netting from unnetted and valuation-allowance amounts. Pension plan assets and obligations differ from recognized employer balances; pension interest cost is not a substitute for all interest expense. Derivative gross, collateral-adjusted, and elected-netting amounts require consistent presentation. Disaggregated income-statement caption amounts require caption context and cannot be summed without it.
candidates: DeferredRevenue = DeferredIncome + ContractWithCustomerLiability has explicit complementary scope, but no complete path to total liabilities established.
DeferredRevenueLeasesCurrent has a definition saying noncurrent; do not infer a usable classification from its name.
Discontinued-operation income components can support the pretax-income bridge only after checking parent/noncontrolling and tax scope.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition. Disposal-group totals are subset amounts, not whole-company operating income or interest. Equity fair value, statutory capital and investee equity are not consolidated book equity. Financial-asset fair-value disclosures, FHLBank regulatory measures, forecast amortization, financing receivable vintages and undiscounted lease payments do not replace carrying balances. FinanceLeaseInterestExpense and FinancingInterestExpense are limited interest components, not sufficient total expense.
candidates: DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInCash + DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInKind may support DividendIncomeOperating, an existing interest-income intermediate. Check paid versus earned/accrued scope before approval; taxable and tax-advantaged categories are not necessarily disjoint.
FinanceLeaseLiability = FinanceLeaseLiabilityPaymentsDue - FinanceLeaseLiabilityUndiscountedExcessAmount is component-only unless a complete liabilities partition is established.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition, including rereading truncated increase/decrease entries. Gain/loss categories can overlap other operating income and nonoperating income. Cash-flow changes and interest paid do not alone determine accrual interest expense (amortization, capitalized interest, noncash settlements and scope differ). Interest expense on deposits, debt, leases, policyholders or specific instruments is not automatically an exhaustive partition of total interest. Repo interest-expense aggregate expressly permits net reporting. InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized includes allowance for funds used during construction and is not an unconditional alias for capitalized interest.
candidates: Pretax continuing income = domestic pretax + foreign pretax; check historical definitions and include as a nested candidate for the before-interest bridge.
Pretax continuing income = continuing income inclusive of NCI + IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit; inclusive continuing income = parent continuing income + continuing NCI.
Pretax continuing income = pretax excluding equity-method income + IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments.
IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit = CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit + DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit; federal/state/local plus foreign is a second candidate partition.
InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvisionForLoanLoss needs exact provision coverage and operating/nonoperating scope before serving as operating net interest.

IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate suggests inverse rate derivation; rounded rates/tax amounts do not establish exact income. Nonmonetary concepts must not be silently called semantically reviewed.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition. Investment-company tax income and net investment income are not company operating income. InvestmentIncomeInterest excludes amortization/accretion and covers nonoperating securities only. Average liabilities and fair-value liabilities differ from reported period-end carrying totals. Insurance present values, reserves, and settlement face values are limited scopes. LongTermDebt and its classified portions expressly exclude lease obligations.
candidates: LiabilitiesNoncurrent = LongTermDebtNoncurrent + LiabilitiesOtherThanLongtermDebtNoncurrent: exact named complement candidate, distinct from previously rejected debt-plus-lease sum; historical scope and real filing tests pending.
LongTermDebtNoncurrent = LongTermDebt - LongTermDebtCurrent; all three exclude leases.

LimitedLiabilityCompanyLlcMembersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest is a full permanent ownership-interest candidate; verify scope and applicable S&P company legal form before adding.
LongTermInvestments can complement AssetsNoncurrentOtherThanNoncurrentInvestmentsAndPropertyPlantAndEquipment only if all excluded other property is also captured; PP&E alone may not cover it.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition, including rereading 4592–4594 after output truncation. NoncurrentAssets excludes financial instruments and other categories and is not AssetsNoncurrent. Cash payments, undiscounted future rents, plan assets, acquired balances and component insurance interest do not replace accrual company totals. OCI before/after tax, reclassification and parent/NCI scopes must match. Generic other assets/liabilities/expenses do not establish their own exhaustive complements.
candidates: MembersEquity + MembersEquityAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest complements LLC inclusive equity; applicability and temporary-equity treatment pending.
NetIncomeLoss + NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest can supply consolidated profit. Nonredeemable-inclusive net income additionally requires redeemable NCI income.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax can be derived from its parent and NCI portions or before-tax less tax; consolidated comprehensive income less consolidated OCI is a net-income candidate.
OperatingExpenses = OperatingCostsAndExpenses + SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense has explicitly complementary definitions; historical verification and tests pending.
NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic requires both preferred and participating-security adjustments to recover parent income; not preferred dividends alone.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition. Cash-flow investing/financing/operating proceeds and payments are not accrual amounts. Utility and oil/gas property, production income and capitalized interest have restricted activity scope. Fair value and redemption value do not substitute for temporary-equity carrying amount. Purchase obligations can include unrecorded commitments. PP&E and real estate investment definitions alone still do not prove a complete noncurrent-assets partition.
candidates: RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue is total operating revenue; regulated plus unregulated revenue is a candidate nested revenue fallback.

RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer minus RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomerExcludingInterestIncome yields interest within non-Topic-606 revenue; check equivalence to operating interest income, not all company interest income.
Revenues minus RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense isolates deducted revenue interest expense; check operating scope and netting before using.

RevenuesExcludingInterestAndDividends plus InterestAndDividendIncomeOperating is a candidate revenue partition; Topic 606 revenue plus RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer also needs assessed-tax and scope compatibility.
PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments is broader than preferred dividends alone; evaluate recovery of parent net income from basic common income against participating securities treatment.

reviewed_ranges.decision: Read every definition. Securities financing netting and collateral adjustments require matching bases; security fair value and hypothetical sensitivities do not supply consolidated totals. SG&A includes indirect selling, unlike SellingAndMarketingExpense limited to direct expenses. Statutory/regulatory capital and income do not substitute for GAAP totals. SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTerms excess concepts apply to a specific all-shares-redemption circumstance. Temporary equity accretion and distributions are not interest expense. Utility operating expense is regulated-operation scope, not all-company expense.
candidates: SecuredLongTermDebt plus UnsecuredLongTermDebt may partition LongTermDebtNoncurrent; classification and carrying-value adjustments need verification.

StockholdersEquityPeriodIncreaseDecrease suggests prior balance plus movement, but current-period restatement/beginning-balance compatibility requires evidence beyond independently fetched prior values.
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsInterestOnIncomeTaxesExpense is component interest with accounting policy classification, not all interest expense.

Operating revenue can use RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue, with nested regulated plus unregulated. UtilitiesOperatingExpense cannot serve as all-company cost without proof of absent unregulated operations.

additional_reviewed_batches.selection: All unique children in official calculation groups
additional_reviewed_batches.decision: All definitions read. Broad component lists overlap or require scope evidence. New exact-definition complement: OperatingExpenses = OperatingCostsAndExpenses + SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.

new_candidates.status: Implemented after 2021–2026 definition comparison and constructed tests; no complete archived real-filing inputs.
new_candidates.nested_result: No unconditional SG&A subpartition approved: direct-selling differs from indirect selling included in SG&A.

nonmonetary_numeric_review.order: Qualified names sorted within US GAAP, then SRT; selected numeric and rate types. All definitions read, indices 0 through 1157 inclusive.
nonmonetary_numeric_review.decision: No new unconditional path to the four monetary totals approved. EPS and tax-rate inversions require matching numerator scope and can amplify rounding; borrowing rates and period-end principal do not determine annual accrued interest. Regulatory ratios use regulatory/risk-weighted/average assets. Security prices, par values and quantities do not establish carrying equity; activity counts and physical volumes do not establish recognized accrual totals. These are definition-screening decisions, not proof that a filing-specific equation is impossible.

candidate_dispositions.operating_expenses_complement: Implemented: OperatingCostsAndExpenses explicitly excludes SG&A; OperatingExpenses explicitly includes it. Same remaining definition, unchanged 2021–2026. Other detailed expense lists are not automatically disjoint.
candidate_dispositions.operating_revenue: Implemented: RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue is explicitly total operating revenue, and regulated/unregulated are complementary portions. Both inputs required. Definitions unchanged 2021–2026.
candidate_dispositions.members_equity: Implemented: inclusive LLC ownership interest or parent plus NCI. Official classified second-alternative reference separately shows temporary equity. No qualifying archived filing exercises this branch; real-world coverage remains unverified.
candidate_dispositions.noncurrent_liabilities: Not approved as unconditional: other-than-long-term-debt definition is limited to normal-operation obligations. Reference group uses debt plus capital leases, while exclusion wording mentions debt only. Definitions alone do not resolve all classification overlap/completeness.
candidate_dispositions.long_term_debt: Nested candidate not integrated because no approved new root path. Total minus current has a 2022 carrying-basis mismatch: total/noncurrent definitions exclude unamortized adjustments while current definition retains prior wording. Secured/unsecured classification alone does not establish matching carrying adjustments.
candidate_dispositions.noncurrent_assets: Not approved: the other-than-investments-and-property aggregate excludes other property as well as PP&E; LongTermInvestmentsAndReceivables can overlap receivables in other assets. NoncurrentAssets is not AssetsNoncurrent.
candidate_dispositions.pretax_before_interest_bridge: Not approved for total interest from definitions alone: the official income template builds this subtotal from operating income, nonoperating income and equity-method income. It does not establish removal of all operating interest already in operating income. Total-interest reversal therefore needs classification evidence.
candidate_dispositions.pretax_operating_bridge: Not approved unconditionally: NonoperatingIncomeExpense definition does not fix inclusion of separately presented interest/debt or equity-method income. InterestAndDebtExpense is broader than interest.
candidate_dispositions.pretax_nested: Continuing after-tax income plus tax, and before-equity-method pretax plus equity-method income are candidate component identities. Not production dependencies because the root bridges above are unresolved. Domestic/foreign template sums to the before-equity-method subtotal; matching samples do not establish inclusive scope.
candidate_dispositions.income_oci_tax_nested: Parent plus NCI, comprehensive income less matching OCI, and current plus deferred tax are candidate component identities, not new main-metric paths. OCI ownership/tax scope must match. No unused income/tax modules added. Two AMD archived tax comparisons conflict; raw XML confirms positive deferred amounts. Cause not established, no sign correction.
candidate_dispositions.net_income_common: PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments is broader than preferred dividends; participation allocations and diluted adjustments prevent blindly reversing EPS/common-income to parent or consolidated income. No main-metric path established.
candidate_dispositions.operating_dividends: Cash-paid and in-kind-paid income definitions do not establish all earned/accrued dividends for the same annual period; no unconditional replacement for DividendIncomeOperating.
candidate_dispositions.revenue_contract_partition: Not approved unconditionally: Topic 606 including/excluding assessed-tax choice must match remaining revenue basis. A generic component list does not establish accounting-policy compatibility.
candidate_dispositions.revenue_interest_partitions: RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer excludes Topic 606, not explicitly all nonoperating interest. Gross versus net revenue isolates interest deducted there, not expressly every operating-interest expense. JPM archived gross/net amounts are equal while operating interest is nonzero; cause not established.
candidate_dispositions.revenue_excluding_interest_dividends: Candidate bank-revenue identity needs matching gross/net and revenue classification. Definition of the excluding subtotal covers operations; presence alone does not prove all operating interest/dividend income is included on the same revenue basis.
candidate_dispositions.capitalized_interest: InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized includes construction allowance (including potential equity return); cannot replace pure capitalized interest without separating it.
candidate_dispositions.cash_interest_and_balance_changes: Cash paid plus accrued-liability movement requires amortization, capitalized amounts, acquisitions/disposals, currency and noncash settlement adjustments. Selected tags alone do not fix complete roll-forward scope.
candidate_dispositions.prior_equity_rollforward: Requires compatible beginning balance/restatement basis and complete movements. Independently fetched prior-year ending equity does not establish current-year opening basis.
candidate_dispositions.component_only_equations: Accretion, deferred revenue, leases, credit allowances, industry expenses and other component identities cannot reach a root until a complete nonoverlapping parent partition is established. Do not add unused modules merely because a local equation is valid.

definition_screening.review_stage: Monetary and selected other-numeric first-pass screening complete; listed candidate dispositions recorded. Not a proof of every possible semantic derivation.
definition_screening.complete_meaning: False refers to exhaustive proof of every semantic derivation, not the completed numeric first-pass screening. Candidate dispositions supersede pending notes recorded during earlier ranges.

taxonomy_decisions.scope: 2026 US GAAP and SRT; not every SEC taxonomy or every semantic accounting equation.

us-gaap:Assets.definition: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.
us-gaap:Assets.decision: Current/noncurrent partition accepted; industry component lists need proof of completeness and nonoverlap.

us-gaap:Liabilities.definition: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.
us-gaap:Liabilities.decision: Current/noncurrent partition accepted; industry component lists need proof of completeness and nonoverlap.

us-gaap:AssetsCurrent.definition: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.
us-gaap:AssetsCurrent.decision: Detailed template lists include alternative classifications. Not approved as a universal partition.

us-gaap:AssetsNoncurrent.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
us-gaap:AssetsNoncurrent.decision: Detailed template lists include alternative classifications and measurement bases. Not approved as a universal partition.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesCurrent.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.
us-gaap:LiabilitiesCurrent.decision: Detailed template list is not established as an exhaustive disjoint partition by definitions alone.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesNoncurrent.definition: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
us-gaap:LiabilitiesNoncurrent.decision: Debt-plus-other candidate: other excludes long-term debt but does not explicitly exclude finance leases. The reference debt subtotal includes leases. Scope evidence needed.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity.definition: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.
us-gaap:LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity.decision: Balance-sheet identity accepted with permanent and temporary equity; CommitmentsAndContingencies in a template is not an extra recognized liability.

us-gaap:AssetsNet.decision: Assets minus liabilities accepted. Investment/noninvestment partition requires compatible carrying/fair-value basis and entity scope.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPorti.definition: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPorti.decision: Parent permanent equity plus permanent noncontrolling equity accepted.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquity.definition: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.
us-gaap:StockholdersEquity.decision: Detailed share/component sums not approved: issued versus outstanding, subscriptions, treasury and other balances require disjoint scope.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityBeforeTreasury.definition: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityBeforeTreasury.decision: Definition includes NCI. Less total treasury stock yields consolidated permanent equity, not parent-only equity.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue.definition: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.
us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue.decision: Common plus preferred treasury stock accepted; both explicitly required.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalIncludingPortionA.definition: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.
us-gaap:PartnersCapitalIncludingPortionA.decision: Parent partners capital plus partners capital attributable to NCI accepted.

us-gaap:PartnersCapital.definition: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.
us-gaap:PartnersCapital.decision: Do not sum ownership classes and retained earnings indiscriminately: the definition does not establish these balances as disjoint.

us-gaap:MinorityInterest.definition: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.
us-gaap:MinorityInterest.decision: Entity types and nonredeemable/VIE interests can overlap. No unconditional sum of listed categories.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountInc.definition: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.
us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountInc.decision: Parent plus redeemable NCI accepted. Maturity schedules need evidence that all temporary equity is covered and measured on carrying-amount basis.

us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterest.definition: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.
us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterest.decision: Common plus preferred plus other carrying amounts accepted; all three required.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.decision: Keep explicit-zero guard for other operating income and government assistance; template alone does not prove amounts excluded from revenues/expenses.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.definition: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.
us-gaap:GrossProfit.decision: Revenues less CostOfRevenue accepted with compatible scope.

us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses.definition: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.
us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses.decision: CostOfRevenue plus OperatingExpenses accepted; reverse identity used for operating expenses.

us-gaap:OperatingExpenses.definition: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.
us-gaap:OperatingExpenses.decision: CostsAndExpenses less CostOfRevenue accepted. OperatingCostsAndExpenses plus SG&A accepted from complementary definitions. Detailed expense templates require nonoverlap evidence.

us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses.definition: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.
us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses.decision: Excludes SG&A. No exhaustive disjoint subpartition established from its detailed expense candidates.

us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeE.definition: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.
us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeE.decision: Includes direct and indirect selling; SellingAndMarketingExpense describes direct expenses and is not an exhaustive selling complement to general administration.

us-gaap:RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperating.definition: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.
us-gaap:RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperating.decision: Total operating revenue; regulated plus unregulated accepted with both required. No generic disjoint subpartition approved for either portion.

us-gaap:LimitedLiabilityCompanyLlcMember.definition: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.
us-gaap:LimitedLiabilityCompanyLlcMember.decision: Parent members equity plus members NCI accepted; temporary equity remains separate in the classified second-alternative reference.

us-gaap:MembersEquity.definition: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.
us-gaap:MembersEquity.decision: Detailed capital/retained-earnings/notes-receivable template is not promoted to an unconditional partition from generic capital wording.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.definition: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.
us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.decision: CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold explicitly excludes financial services/other earning activities. Detailed components need completeness and classification evidence.

us-gaap:Revenues.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).
us-gaap:Revenues.decision: Contract/noncontract partition is a candidate; including/excluding assessed tax must match reporting policy. Banking template uses net interest whereas generic definition includes gross interest. Do not promote all templates to universal equations.

us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.definition: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.
us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.decision: No universal complete disjoint component equation approved.

us-gaap:NoninterestIncome.definition: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.
us-gaap:NoninterestIncome.decision: Contract/noncontract income partition requires matching tax and interest scope; not an unconditional replacement for revenues.

us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).
us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.decision: Gross/net reversal needs same revenue basis and classification of interest deducted in revenue.

us-gaap:InterestExpense.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.
us-gaap:InterestExpense.decision: Operating/nonoperating partition, total income less net interest, and incurred less capitalized accepted from definitions. Other in reference template is not automatically an additional disjoint bucket.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating.definition: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating.decision: Combined operating interest/dividend income less operating dividends accepted. Securities-only or cash/kind investment lists do not establish all operating interest.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.definition: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.
us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.decision: Securities-only aggregate cannot stand for all operating interest plus dividends.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperating.definition: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.
us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperating.decision: Cash/kind and taxable/security lists need complete coverage; no unconditional new derivation approved.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet.definition: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet.decision: Total net minus nonoperating net accepted; listed bank categories may overlap aggregate InterestIncomeOperating.

us-gaap:InterestRevenueExpenseNet.definition: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.
us-gaap:InterestRevenueExpenseNet.decision: Operating plus nonoperating net accepted under reviewed 2024+ definition; older wording narrower.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatin.definition: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatin.decision: InvestmentIncomeInterest is securities-only before accretion/amortization. Not an unconditional all-nonoperating-interest input.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonope.definition: Amount of interest income classified as operating and nonoperating.
us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonope.decision: Total less operating can identify nonoperating income; securities-only InvestmentIncomeInterest is not a universal substitute.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOperating.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.
us-gaap:InterestExpenseOperating.decision: Operating interest income minus operating net accepted. Deposit/debt/component template not independently proven exhaustive.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating.definition: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.
us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating.decision: Total income minus operating income minus nonoperating net accepted when all inputs supplied. Debt/lease/cost template not independently exhaustive.

us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurred.definition: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.
us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurred.decision: Debt expense plus capitalized/AFUDC template is not a universal total: debt expense scope and equity return may differ.

us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized.definition: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.
us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized.decision: Includes construction allowance; not an unconditional pure capitalized-interest substitute.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmount.definition: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.
us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmount.decision: Operating plus nonoperating assistance income accepted with 2024+ meanings. 2022 definition was broader.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvis.definition: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvis.decision: Net-before-provision bridge needs the after-provision scope to be operating; its definition does not expressly establish that classification.

us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLos.definition: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.
us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLos.decision: Loss categories need complete nonoverlapping scope; cannot repair an unestablished after-provision classification.

us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.definition: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.
us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.decision: Other expense categories may already enter operating expenses; no unconditional component sum approved.

us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense.definition: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.
us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense.decision: Broader than interest. Debt-related costs and classification prevent unconditional substitution.

us-gaap:NonoperatingIncomeExpense.definition: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).
us-gaap:NonoperatingIncomeExpense.decision: Definition does not explicitly exclude separately reported interest or equity-method amounts. Pretax-to-operating bridge requires presentation evidence.

us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperatio.definition: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.
us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperatio.decision: Pretax less nonoperating plus interest/debt template requires exact inclusion/exclusion evidence.

us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperatio.definition: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).
us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperatio.decision: Before-interest subtotal includes nonoperating/equity-method income, not operating income. Prior candidate retained in screen_interest_candidates.py; no tested filing supplied it.

us-gaap:CapitalizationLongtermDebtAndEqu.definition: Amount of consolidated capitalization which comprises long-term debt and equity instruments.
us-gaap:CapitalizationLongtermDebtAndEqu.decision: Definition says debt and equity instruments but does not explicitly delimit temporary equity or current portions; no unconditional permanent-equity derivation.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome.definition: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.
us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome.decision: Listed loan/security income and aggregate operating interest can overlap; not a universally disjoint sum.

us-gaap:BenefitsLossesAndExpenses.definition: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.
us-gaap:BenefitsLossesAndExpenses.decision: Insurance presentation-specific aggregate: no unconditional operating-expenses extraction without matching component scope.

us-gaap:Assets.2021: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.
us-gaap:Assets.2024: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

us-gaap:AssetsCurrent.2021: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.
us-gaap:AssetsCurrent.2024: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

us-gaap:AssetsNoncurrent.2021: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:BenefitsLossesAndExpenses.2021: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

us-gaap:CapitalizationLongtermDebtAndEqu.2021: This element represents the total consolidated (as applicable) capitalization of the entity which is comprised of its long-term debt and equity instruments. The table may be detailed by subsidiary (legal entity) and include information by type of debt or equity detailed by instrument.
us-gaap:CapitalizationLongtermDebtAndEqu.2024: Amount of consolidated capitalization which comprises long-term debt and equity instruments.

us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.2021: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses.2021: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperating.2021: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceAmount.2024: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceNonoperating.2024: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as nonoperating.

us-gaap:GovernmentAssistanceOperatingInc.2024: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as operating.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.2021: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperatio.2021: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense.2021: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperati.2021: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurit.2021: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalized.2021: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalizedAdjustme.2021: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurred.2021: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurredCapitalized.2021: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.

us-gaap:InterestExpense.2021: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.
us-gaap:InterestExpense.2024: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating.2024: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

us-gaap:InterestExpenseOperating.2024: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvis.2021: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet.2021: The net amount of operating interest income (expense).
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet.2024: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatin.2021: The net amount of nonoperating interest income (expense).
us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatin.2024: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating.2021: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonope.2024: Amount of interest income classified as operating and nonoperating.

us-gaap:InterestRevenueExpenseNet.2021: Amount of interest revenue (income derived from investments in debt securities and on cash and cash equivalents) net of interest expense (cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest).
us-gaap:InterestRevenueExpenseNet.2024: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.

us-gaap:Liabilities.2021: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.
us-gaap:Liabilities.2024: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity.2021: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesCurrent.2021: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LiabilitiesNoncurrent.2021: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LimitedLiabilityCompanyLlcMember.2021: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:MembersEquity.2021: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.

us-gaap:MembersEquityAttributableToNonco.2021: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.

us-gaap:MinorityInterest.2021: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (that is, noncontrolling interest, previously referred to as minority interest).
us-gaap:MinorityInterest.2023: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

us-gaap:NetInvestmentIncome.2021: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

us-gaap:NoninterestIncome.2021: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

us-gaap:NonoperatingIncomeExpense.2021: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses.2021: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

us-gaap:OperatingExpenses.2021: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.2021: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.2021: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

us-gaap:PartnersCapital.2021: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAttributableToNon.2021: Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

us-gaap:PartnersCapitalIncludingPortionA.2021: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLos.2021: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterest.2021: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
Amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity, classified as other equity.

As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

us-gaap:RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperating.2021: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RegulatedOperatingRevenue.2021: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

us-gaap:RevenueNotFromContractWithCustom.2021: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

us-gaap:Revenues.2021: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.2021: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeE.2021: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquity.2021: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.
us-gaap:StockholdersEquity.2023: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityBeforeTreasury.2021: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPorti.2021: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.
us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPorti.2023: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAtt.2021: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountInc.2021: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonValue.2021: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockPreferredValue.2021: Amount allocated to previously issued preferred shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue.2021: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

us-gaap:UnregulatedOperatingRevenue.2021: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.
